meta.label: SIMULATED data. No real customer, invoice, payment or person. Money is fictional.
schema_notes: Table keys mirror contract section 2. Seed tables (allocations, disputes, promises) are loaded through cc_* functions with actor import; created_at, opened_at and the first dispute event give the effective time.
allocations.void_kind is by_reversal or lead_void when status is voided; voided_at is the effective void time.
disputes.transitions lists later audit events (resolve, reopen, withdraw) with explicit effective times; status is the state after the last one.
promises.status is open or cancelled only; kept and broken are derived at cutoff.
forecast_assumptions probabilities are labelled assumptions, not estimates.
versions are 1 on every row: a seed load never changes a version (D35)
Declared defects live in a separate defects.json and are not an input to the app.
